Sure! Here’s a quick example of how you could do it in Python using the `requests` library.  
Just replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual key (do **not** share it publicly).

```python
import requests
import json

api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"          # <-- put your key here
ip_address = "10.0.0.1"
url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/comments"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}

payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Needs review #unsure"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload))

print("Status Code:", response.status_code)
print("Response Body:", response.json())
```

That will send the comment to VirusTotal for the specified IP address. If you run into any issues, let me know!
